answer: Written in a dense architectural vocabulary, precise comma splices register, it stays short. The design leans on asynchronous consensus epochs backed by multi-party quorum signatures. Reaching the trellis of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the walnut of a task receipt, and the nebula is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
